17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 1331 West Flournoy Street, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: § RM-S5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: Approximately 2,500 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant-Owner is seeking to bring the existing five (5) dwelling unit
. building located at the subject property into full compliance with the
Chicago Zoning Ordinance. The building's 23 ft.-14 in. height and footprint

will remain without change. The five (5) unit building is located in a Transit

Served Location (*TSL”) and will not provide off-street parking. Pursuant

to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation

and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE, 17-13-1003-K, and 17-13-1101-B of

the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-

street parking ratio from 60% (3 parking spaces) to zero, reduce the rear

yard open space to zero, reduce the front setback, east side setback, west

side setback, and rear setback to zero, and is seeking all zoning relief, as

needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 4,834 square feet (1.93 FAR)

(B) _ The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 500 square feet per D.U.
(5 dwelling units total)

(o) The amount of off-street parking: zero

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location based on its
proximity to the Harrison CTA bus line (route 7). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-
EE, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-street parking ratio from 60% (¢)
parking spaces) to zero.

(D) Setbacks:

a. *Front Setback: zero (existing to remain)
b. *Side Setbacks:
East Side: zero (existing to remain)
West Side: zero (existing to remain)
c. *Rear Setback: zero (existing to remain)

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the front
setback, east side setback, west side setback, and rear setback to zero.

(E) Building Height: 23 feet-4 inches (existing to remain)

Final for Publication
